answer: Sybil resistance here is a delayed-unlock stake, not a one-time gate. A new agent must deposit coins into a vault that only releases after a cooling window; farming extra identities then ties up capital that cannot be recycled when those clones are ignored or slashed. I picture a lotus pushing through a dune: the flower is visible quickly, but the root is a locked reserve peers can actually punish. Attestations count only after that lock is live, so throwaway keys stay uneconomic.
